The ACP, Yelahanka New Town Sub-division, Bengaluru has submitted Charge-sheet against the accused persons for the offences punishable under Section U/sec.498A, 323, 504, 506 of IPC &
sec.3, 4 of D.P.Act & u/s.323, 504 r/w.3(2),(va) of the SC/ST (POA) Act, 1989.
2. The prosecution case is that, the victim and accused No.1 married on 17.10.2022 intercaste marriage by falling in love.

The victim belongs to Adi Karnataka caste abused her by taking her caste name alongwith accused No.1 husband the other accused persons namely sister-in-law, brother-in- law, mother-in-law and father-in-law ill-treated the victim while they were residing in the joint family at No.651, 4th Phase, 4th cross, Yelahanka in a rented house.

The complainant submits after their marriage she joined the matrimonial house, they were living happily for a period of 4 months, after that mother- in-law, father-in-law, mentioned they are not going to drink even water from the hands of the victim and abused her 'you are very lower caste, you are bad woman to their family and other persons namely elder sister of the victim's husband.
All of them ill-treated the victim, abused her and even directed her to bring amount.
Even then victim adjusted to the ill-treatment.

In the meantime victim became pregnant, as such she was sent to maternal house, even in the maternal house, the accused No.1 came there and abused his father and mother even assaulted them and mentioned they have no any status to come to the matrimonial house and even after child birth they did not visited the hospital nor the victim to see the child when the victim tried to rejoin the family, after child birth the child has been abused being in black colour and victim has been assaulted and driven from the matrimonial house.
Even after that once again they promised if she brings amount they may think about taking her back to matrimonial house.

accordingly victim once again lodged complaint on 25.06.2024, the jurisdictional police received the complaint and registered crime No.391/2024.
3.
The charge sheet copies were furnished to the accused persons as contemplated under Section 207 of Cr.P.C. Heard before the charge.
As there was sufficient materials available, charge framed for the offences punishable u/sec.323, 504, 506 of IPC & sec.3, 4 of D.P.Act & u/s.323, 504 r/w.3(2),(va) of the SC/ST (POA) Act, 1989,
read over and explained to the accused persons in vernacular language and they pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.

Yelahanka Sub Division, when complainant asked to golden ornaments, he subjected her to mental and physical cruelty and thereby committed the offence punishable under Section 498(A) of IPC?
2) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that on 25.06.2024 and place accused Nos.2 to 5 in furtherance of their common intention assaulted with hands and caused pain and thereby committed an offence u/sec.323 r/w.149 of IPC?
3) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that on aforesaid date, time and place, the accused persons in prosecution of their common intention after 4 marriage of accused No.1 with C.W.1, C.W.1 was 4 months pregnant, accused persons have intentionally insulted and sent C.W.1 to her parental house and thereby gave provocation to CW1 intending that such provocation will cause the said CW1 to break the public peace and thereby committed the offence punishable under Section 504 r/w.149 of IPC ?
4) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that on 22.06.2024 time and place,
the accused persons in prosecution of their common intention have committed criminal intimidation by threatening that if she comes back to her matrimonial house and give complaint to Yelahanka New Town Ps vs A1 Ravikiran H B on 3 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95569909/
3 police station, they will not live her alive with injury to her person with intent to cause alarm to her and thereby committed the offence Punishable under Section 506 r/w.149 of IPC?

sentences.text: The complainant deposes in her examination in chief that accused persons are her relatives namely her husband, In-laws, sister-in-law and her husband.
She belongs to Adi Karnataka schedule caste and the accused persons are belonging to Lingayath community.
The complainant deposes she fell in love with accused No.1, on 17.10.2022 they married.
Out of the wedlock there is one male child, now they are all leading happy life.

8. The complainant deposed after the birth of the child, the accused persons did not visited to see the child, as such she was totally disturbed and reported before the jurisdictional police about the same.
This witness deposes she does not know the contents of the complaint and what are all written in the same, she cannot recollect.
This witness deposes she has placed documents namely photographs taken during the marriage and also marriage invitation Ex.P.3.
She deposed police have visited the spot and conducted Mahazar as per Ex.P.4.
This witness deposes she cannot give the particulars of other persons who have come alongwith ACP.
This witness has not been once again called by the police and recorded further statement.
Her further statement is marked as Ex.P.5.
This witness deposes she has compromised with her In-laws and her husband.
9. The learned SPP treated the witness as hostile and even after cross examination nothing has been elicited so as to discard the trust worthiness.
In proof this with regard to causing harassment to the victim mentally and physically, even the parents, brother of the victim are examined as PWs.2 to 4.

sentences.text: Where the Hon'ble Apex Court was quashed the criminal proceedings having regard to the fact that the dispute between the offender and the victim has been settled all though offences are not compoundable.

It does so as in its opinion, the continuation of criminal proceedings will be of exercises in fatality and justice in the case demands that disputes between the parties is public to end and peace is restored.
Securing the ends of justice being the ultimate guiding factor.

No duty crimes are accepts, which have harmful affect on the public and consist in wrong doing that seriously endangers and threaten the well being of the society and its not safe to leave crime does only because he and the victim have settled the dispute amicably or that victim has been ordered compensation, yet certain crimes have been made compoundable in law, who with or if the compromise of the Court.
(Part 61 and 58)"
11. The learned SPP submits the offence punishable u/s.498A of IPC is not punishable.

However the hostility of the complainant and even by examining other material witnesses will not be sufficient to substitute the evidence of the complainant, by way of circumstantial evidence the evidence punishable u/s.498A proved.
Therefore this court can pass suitable orders considering the materials on record.

12. In the case on hand as the complainant herself deposed before this court that she has compromised with the accused and she does not supports the prosecution, as such this court cannot presume that the incident happened as per the complainant case.
As such even in the complaint majority of the alleged offence are only against accused No.1 which are prompted by the accused Nos.2 to 5 is the allegation.
The hostility of material witnesses, this court is satisfied to answer the Point No.1 in the Negative.
13. POINTS NO.2 TO 4:
The prosecution basically relies on the evidence of PWs.1 to 4.

These witnesses do not depose about any incident happened so as to cause assault and breach of public Yelahanka New Town Ps vs A1 Ravikiran H B on 3 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95569909/
5 peace.

sentences.text: The accused being given life threat has not been mentioned by any of the material witnesses.

None of the witnesses have eposed about ingredients of alleged offence punishable u/s.323, 504,
506 of IPC.
Accordingly, this court is satisfied to answer these Point Nos.2 to 4 in the Negative.

14. POINT NO.5: In proof of the ingredients of offence punishable u/s.3 and 4 of DP Act, in the complaint, the complainant has specifically hand written about the accused persons demanding golden ornaments and silver articles as on 22.06.2024.
On 25.06.2024 even accused No.1 came and abused the victim unless she brings golden ornaments and silver she will not be allowed to join him in the matrimonial house.

In this case, even the other accused persons have instigated the accused No.1 to commit the alleged offence and they have also collected and made efforts, by preventing the victim joining the matrimonial house.
In this regad, the Investigating Officer has conducted spot Mahazar which is an undisputed one.
In the spot Mahazar, victim has specifically deposed about police drawing spot Mahazar in presence of panchas.
In the case on hand, considering the evidence of the complainant, being hostile, the panchas are not being able to be secured.
Accordingly, by noting the prayer of the learned SPP, they have been dropped from the evidence.
The marriage is undisputed.

As such Ex.P.2 to 5 makes clear about their relationship, however with regard to any demand of dowry though complainant has specifically mentioned in complaint she fails to support the same in her evidence before the court.
The complainant has specified in the evidence that she has compromised now and she has been looked after well by accused persons.

Under such circumstances, in the absence of demand of dowry being supported even by the family members of the victim namely PWs.2 to 4, there is no any material placed by the prosecution to bring home the guilt of the accused with regard to making demand of dowry or which is to be specified.

Accordingly,
this court is satisfied to answer this Point No.5 in the Negative.
15. POINT NO.6:
The prosecution to prove the ingredients of offence punishable u/s.3(2)(va) of SC/ST (POA) Act 1989 in the case on hand the offence punishable u/s.498A and 506 of IPC are non-bailable.
In the case on hand, the offence punishable u/s.498A of IPC the punishment vary upto 3 years.

In fact though alleged offence punishable u/s.498A of IPC is alleged in the complaint, the evidence of the complainant does not inspire this court to consider the ingredients of offence punishable u/s.498A of IPC being established.
Under such circumstances accused being subject to suffer imprisonment for a period of more than 3 years has not been established.
Accordingly when the alleged offence punishable under IPC is itself not proved, this court is satisfied to answer this Point No.6 in the Negative.

16. POINT No.7 :- In view of my foregoing reasons, this court without reserving the matter for hearing on sentence proceeds to pass the following order:
ORDER

Acting under Section 235(1) of Cr.P.C, the accused Nos.1 to 5 are hereby acquitted for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 of IPC &
sec.3, 4 of D.P.Act & sec.3(2),(va) of the SC/ST (POA) Act, 1989.
The Bail bonds and surety  bonds of accused Nos.1 to 5 stand  cancelled.
